text: In 1630s New England, William and his family are [banished from their Puritan settlement|wrong|the outsider punished] and build a farm at the edge of [a vast and secluded forest|images|wild and lonely places]. When baby Samuel vanishes in his sister Thomasin's care, [a witch has stolen him|wants|a child to take or have], and grief, hunger and a missing silver cup turn the family's suspicion toward Thomasin. Meanwhile the young twins insist that their billy goat, Black Phillip, [talks to them|threat|the devil and dark gods].
